submittedParameters.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit IMAGE1 exactly, one native1254x1254 transparentRGBA sprite. Image2 bamboo girl is ONLY an example of southeast shoe yaw, not a pose to copy; image3 is approved painted style.
Preserve every original pixel arrangement outside the ankle/boot regions as closely as possible. Lock head, face, torso, pelvis, all knee locations, shin bends, both boot centers, original gait phase, scarf, arms, both hands and both daggers. The ONLY change is a small anatomically coherent 3D yaw of the ankles and boots so the heel-to-toe axis points diagonally DOWN-RIGHT (SE), with the appropriate front/top shoe view, not sideways EAST or straight SOUTH. Moon patterns, goldstraps and boot size remain.
Both legs are TUCKED/BENT in flight. The lower screen-right boot folds BACK under its knee and stays at the original normalized1024 box x535..635,y810..945. Do not extend that leg forward to the lower-right edge or straighten its calf. The other lifted boot stays precisely in its own original position.
Keep original boot height and foot pitch: lifted soles and raised heels must stay lifted, and the same calf remains folded. Do not borrow a planted-foot contact pose. No floor, shadow, translation, enlargement, mirroring, crop, new limbs or text. Whole original composition and margins stay unchanged; only subtle local boot direction adjustment.
